environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB (not internet-facing). External access is routed through AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a usage plan requiring a valid x-api-key. The API Gateway resource for /api/v1/products/search has request validation enabled with a request validator that enforces the 'order' query string parameter to match the regex pattern '^(ASC|DESC)$' via a JSON schema in the method request's URL Query String Parameters model. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a request parameter mapping that drops any query parameter not in the explicitly defined set (warehouse, name, sort, order). The integration type is HTTP_PROXY to the internal ALB.
